decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_layout: card-style — hero content inside a floating card/panel
hero_height: full viewport — 100vh with scroll cue below
nav_style: hidden on scroll down, shows on scroll up
scroll_animation: none — everything static and immediately visible
cursor_effect: magnetic effect — buttons slightly attract cursor on hover
border_radius: pill — fully rounded on small elements
color_scheme: mixed — alternating dark and light sections
bonus_quirk: footer includes a tiny randomly chosen emoji that changes daily
